interface.title: FlowScope
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and quality control of a single acquired sample, then reporting
interface.what_it_is_for: Load an FCS file, run a fixed parse→compensate→arcsinh→FlowSOM-style clustering→UMAP pipeline, look over populations through a UMAP, a frequency bar chart, a marker heatmap and a summary table, flag clusters that look like artifacts with a z-score/IsolationForest detector that uses no AI, and export a reproducible report with the file checksum and run settings. An LLM interpretation step is optional.

data.note: Two runs used the bundled real 13-colour BD FACSAria PBMC sample (flowio-demo/pbmc_13color_facsaria.fcs, 65,016 events). The dropdown listed only this file; there was no synthetic file. The uploaded test file synth-a.fcs (1.1 MB) loaded, but the pipeline rejected it because it has no embedded $SPILLOVER compensation matrix (screens/044.webp). No AI key was set, so all AI buttons stayed greyed out.

tree.general: Find the cell populations in one cytometry sample, flag groups that may be technical artifacts so they can be judged as artifact or real biology, and record the run reproducibly
tree.specific: Cluster the PBMC FCS sample, inspect UMAP, frequencies and heatmap, run the deterministic anomaly detector, and download the detection-only LIMS-style report (the AI artifact-vs-real interpretation was locked without an API key)

features.name: Parameterised deterministic clustering run panel
features.general: A sidebar form where you pick an input file, set preprocessing and clustering settings with sliders and a seed, then run a fixed pipeline whose settings are recorded for reproducibility
features.specific: Choose an FCS file or upload one (uploads need an embedded $SPILLOVER matrix), set the arcsinh cofactor (5–500), Events subsampled (5000–50000) and Metaclusters (5–30) sliders and the Random seed stepper, then click Run analysis; the results header shows Total events, Analyzed and Metaclusters
steps: Pick or upload a data file
Read the help tooltips for each setting
Adjust the transform, subsample and cluster-count sliders and the seed
Click Run analysis and wait for the progress status
Read the summary metrics header
serves_tasks: Pick a sample file to analyse
Set transform scale, subsample size, number of populations and random seed
Run the processing and clustering pipeline

features.name: Population size overview: frequency chart and per-cluster summary table
features.general: See how large each population is and what its median marker levels are, reading exact percentages off a chart of group sizes and ordering a table of counts so rare groups come to the top
features.specific: The 'Cluster frequencies' chart (hover a bar for cluster and frequency_pct; 'Show data' flips it to a table) together with the 'Per-cluster summary table' (cluster, n_events, frequency_pct, per-marker medians; click a header to sort; toolbar Show/hide columns, Search, Download as CSV, Fullscreen — the CSV download produced no file in this run)
steps: Hover a bar to read a cluster's exact percentage
Click Show data to read all frequencies as a table
Scroll to the per-cluster summary table
Sort by n_events ascending to bring the rarest clusters to the top
Read the marker medians of those rare clusters
serves_tasks: Compare the relative size of each population
Inspect per-population counts and marker medians, ordered to bring rare groups forward

features.name: Cluster-by-marker median heatmap with UMAP companion
features.general: Read the identity of each group from a heatmap of median marker levels next to a 2D embedding coloured by the same group labels
features.specific: The 'UMAP embedding, colored by cluster' image (can open full screen) and the 'Marker expression heatmap (median, transformed scale)' with 13 panel markers
steps: Look at the UMAP to see which clusters sit apart
Open the UMAP full screen for detail
Read the heatmap row for that cluster to see which markers are high or low
serves_tasks: See how populations separate in a 2D embedding
Identify each population by its marker profile

features.name: Rule-plus-model outlier flagging table
features.general: Flag unusual groups with two transparent statistical tests and list which test flagged each group, with the scores, so a person can review them
features.specific: Anomaly detection (deterministic): a frequency z-score and an IsolationForest over per-cluster feature vectors give an 'N of M clusters flagged' line and a table with frequency_pct, freq_zscore, iforest_flag and flagged_by
steps: Run the pipeline
Read the count of flagged clusters
For each flagged cluster check whether it came from the z-score or the IsolationForest
Cross-check flagged clusters against the heatmap and frequencies
Re-run with other settings and compare the flags
serves_tasks: Review which clusters a statistical outlier detector flags and why

features.name: Provenance-stamped report builder and download
features.general: Turn the current analysis into a disclaimered Markdown report with the input file's checksum, exact parameters, software version and a per-flag section, then download it
features.specific: 'Build report without AI (detection only)' renders a FlowScope Analysis Report (Entry, Analysis Provenance with File SHA-256, compensation source, cofactor, subsample, seed and version, a cluster frequency table, and a 'Flagged clusters — interpretation' section), then 'Download report (.md)'. 'Generate AI report' stays disabled without an API key.
steps: Click Build report without AI (detection only)
Read the provenance section and the flagged-cluster sections on the page
Click Download report (.md)
serves_tasks: Build and export a disclaimered report with input checksum and exact parameters

features.name: Known-answer evaluation panel for an automated classifier
features.general: An expandable panel that shows how accurate an optional automated judgement step was on a benchmark with known answers, broken down by model and by true category, with confidence intervals and stated limits
features.specific: The 'How far can the AI step be trusted?' expander: a model table (agreement, 95% CI, artifact called real, real called artifact, abstained), a baseline line for the detector alone, a 'Correct calls by true cluster type' grid, and Reading-it / Limits notes
steps: Expand the panel
Compare models by agreement and CI
Check per-category correct calls for weak spots (for example Doublet_T_Mono, Plasmablast)
Read the limits before relying on the AI step
serves_tasks: Review benchmark accuracy of the optional AI classifier against known answers
